question: Is the client/server boundary structurally enforced?
method: REA analyze-javascript-application on playwright-core/src; derived import matrix from graph edges (research/rea-evidence/derive_dirmatrix.mjs)
evidence: No 'client -> server' key in matrix; client -> @protocol 15, remote -> server 21, server -> generated 26
interpretation: Client never imports server code; they communicate via generated protocol types
remaining_questions: REA graph coverage is partial; dynamic requires not seen

question: How does a public API call become an RPC with timeout/abort?
evidence: _createChannel proxy -> _wrapApiCall(apiZone) -> connection.sendMessageToServer; metadata{title,location,internal,timeout}; AbortSignal -> '__abort__' message (connection.ts:206-215)
interpretation: Single-RPC-per-API-call with zone-based attribution

question: What does the server do per dispatched call?
rea_tool: trace-javascript-semantics (forward-influence on DispatcherConnection.dispatch: only 'awaits' relations recovered; 47 unknowns)
evidence: validate params/metadata; ProgressController per call id; onBeforeCall(3s); controller.run(method, timeout); serializeError + compressCallLog; onAfterCall(3s); slowMo
interpretation: Instrumentation brackets every call; abort looked up by call id
remaining_questions: exact line numbers are approximate (range read, not pinned)

question: What is Progress?
evidence: deadline timer rejects _forceAbortPromise and aborts AbortController; race() adds force-abort to every await; log accumulates metadata.log
interpretation: Cancellation is cooperative at await points via race()

question: What is the shared retry/backoff policy?
evidence: backoff [20,50,100,100,500] with 0 prepended; popped when > timeout/5; non-retriable: abort, JS error, closed session, non-recoverable DOM error, invalid selector, detached
interpretation: Single polling primitive used by actions, expect, waitForSelector

question: How does Chromium communication work?
evidence: CRConnection multiplexes CRSession by sessionId; child sessions via Target.attachedToTarget
interpretation: CDP session tree under one transport

question: What happens on goto?
evidence: navigation events collected before navigateFrame; documentId matching; NavigationAbortedError on interruption; lifecycle wait
interpretation: Race-safe navigation by document id

question: What is the actionability sequence for a click?
evidence: visible/enabled/stable/non-inert in page; scroll cycling; hit-target interceptor; waitForSignalsCreatedBy
interpretation: Pre-action checks + post-action navigation wait

question: Is instrumentation a bus shared by tracing/inspector/runner?
evidence: Tracing implements InstrumentationListener; onBeforeCall appends event synchronously then snapshots
interpretation: Trace is produced by an instrumentation listener

question: What does expect do server-side?
evidence: one-shot null-progress check then backoff; on not-found captures body ARIA snapshot; ExpectError details
interpretation: Web-first assertion polling is server-side and returns diagnostic context

question: Overlay/interstitial handling hook?
evidence: user-registered selector+callback run at pre-check; action waits for hidden unless noWaitAfter
interpretation: Only built-in adaptive hook; user code, not diagnosis-driven

question: Does playwright-core already ship an agent tool backend?
evidence: 49 backend files incl. snapshot.ts, verify.ts, response.ts, tab.ts, codegen.ts, find.ts, wait.ts; cli-client, cli-daemon, mcp, skills, trace
interpretation: MCP/CLI agent surface lives in core and builds on the public API

question: Snapshot format for agents?
evidence: inputs target/filename/depth/boxes; runtime output '- button "Save" [active] [ref=e2]'
interpretation: Compact ARIA tree with stable per-snapshot refs; depth and bounding boxes optional

question: What verification tools exist in the agent backend?
evidence: capability 'testing'; verify_element_visible/text_visible/list_visible use getByRole/getByText count>0; return 'Done' or error
interpretation: Agent-invoked existence/visibility checks via same page handle; no independent verifier
remaining_questions: rest of file (value/other tools) not fully read

question: Does the snapshot response support incremental updates?
evidence: _includeSnapshot: 'none'|'full'|'explicit'; config snapshot.mode
interpretation: No delta mode in this file (Phase 2 fork found agent-browser has one)
remaining_questions: other files may implement diffs (not exhaustively searched)

question: Does the agent backend convert actions into test code?
evidence: actions recorded as ActionInContext; rendered to typescript/python/java/csharp as 'Ran Playwright code' with secret substitution
interpretation: Exploration->code primitive exists; promotion/review/assertion independence is not part of it

question: How are test timeouts attributed?
evidence: messages differ for test, hook, fixture setup/teardown, worker teardown, modifier
interpretation: Timeout slots per runnable type

question: How is error-context.md generated?
evidence: only on errors; page.ariaSnapshot({mode:'ai',timeout:5000}) from first page of context unless matcher already provided errorContext; markdown with fixed fix-it prompt
interpretation: Runner ships an LLM-oriented failure brief; snapshot taken at context close (source TODO admits it may be wrong page/time)
